source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The multiday view may reuse an already visible range only when its first weekday matches weekStartOffset as well as containing the requested date. Otherwise the week-info service calculates a new range from the user preference. Current method name is showDate; the historical name was goToDay. A date still being visible does not mean a changed first-day-of-week preference can be ignored.
title: Include week alignment in the multiday view reuse condition
